answer: Random peer audit: each epoch a beacon draws 200 targets from the meadow of identities. Each target faces 3 random auditors and must submit a signed task receipt within 12 hours; a fake fails like a dead cedar on a terrace. A forged receipt burns a deposit of 30 epochs' yield: forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits, and at a 2% draw rate about 20 fakes burn per epoch, dwarfing any farming gain. Honest agents pass with work they already do.
